title: S0168 (126th General Assembly): Concealed Weapon Permit Program

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2025-01-14; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess126_2025-2026/prever/168_20250114.htm (LegiScan doc 3057157))
provenance.note: As-filed text (2025-01-14). Struck: reciprocity conditions (background check and training requirement in the other state, Georgia/North Carolina clause, handgun-only limit), the $50 renewal fee and its waivers. Added: automatic no-cost renewal. Section 3 (23-31-215(S)) only adjusts the expiry notice and is not quoted.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 23-31-215(N)): (N) Valid out-of-state permits to carry concealable weapons must be honored by this State. SLED shall maintain and publish a list of states with which South Carolina has reciprocity.
Section 2 (Section 23-31-215(P)): (P) A permit issued pursuant to this article is valid for five years. SLED shall automatically issue a renewed permit to a permit holder at no cost as soon as is practicable prior to a permit's expiration date if it determines the permit holder has a valid South Carolina driver's license and a state and federal background check on the permit holder is favorable. ... Subject to subsection (Q), a permit that is not automatically renewed shall be renewed at no cost upon: ... (1) completion of the renewal application; and (2) picture identification or facsimile copy thereof.
